Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the quick follow. Rajesh (CTO) and I are excited to see Redwood in action — our VP of Product (Lena Morgan) and Rajesh both want to attend the main demo. What's most helpful for us is: a firm 60‑minute slot, with a short 15‑minute prebrief for internal alignment the morning of the demo. Do you have availability next week (May 29–31) in the afternoons (US Pacific)?

Also — we will need a short list of attendees to share with our security team. I can attach once you confirm names.

Best,

- 15 min prebrief (hosted by Marissa) for stakeholders on the morning of the demo (we can do 30 min if you prefer)
- 60 min demo: first 25–30 min = exec walkthrough (Karthik + Vivek hit SLA, routing policies, private deployment model)
  then 30–35 min = deep technical run (Marissa + Vivek cover batching, quantization recommendations, live Q&A)

Candidates for demo dates/times (US Pacific):
- Tue, May 30: 1:30–2:30pm or 3:00–4:00pm PT
- Wed, May 31: 2:00–3:00pm PT

If those look good I can send calendar holds and a short agenda. Who would you prefer present on the exec section — you mentioned Lena (VP); would Lena like a 1:1 intro with our CRO prior to the demo or is the prebrief sufficient?

Attaching a draft agenda and sponsor prebrief notes.

Thanks,
